plan.title: decomp.wtf: Matching Accuracy, Performance and Analysis Integration

checkout.notes: Upstream repo HEAD is the discontinued final release; this fork continues development from the reviewed commit.

dev_env.layout: .venv created with --system-site-packages plus a .pth file exposing the decompnet tool-venv site-packages
dev_env.tool_venv: ~/.local/share/uv/tools/decompnet (runtime deps: capstone 5.0.7, mcp, pyelftools, splat64[mips], spimdisasm, rabbitizer, httpx, uvicorn, ninja)

toolchains.notes: Each toolchain dir carries its own .decompnet-toolchain.json manifest (pinned versions). PSX GCC 2.7.2/2.8.1 and m2c are present on this host; GameCube/Wii (dtk) and IDO lanes are not installed here.

ghidra.notes: Pinned Ghidra version and Java runtime recorded from the real-lane measurement run.

rea.status: installed, admission verified; P9.8 comparison not measured (no admissible ET_EXEC MIPS artifact)
rea.notes: REA 6.4.0 capability gate rejects the ET_REL demo object; see the real-lanes comparison for the recorded admission result.

failure_classes.linux_gcc_fixtures: tests that compile projects/demo with the host 'gcc' fail on macOS because gcc is clang and rejects the demo's Linux flag set (e.g. -fno-reorder-blocks-and-partition, -flive-patching=inline-only-static)
failure_classes.fork_toolchains: tests/test_fork_judge.py and tests/test_forks.py need objdiff/dtk builds on Linux; errored via subprocess
failure_classes.updates: test_updates tests exercise uv/network paths not available in the sandboxed dev environment

baseline_tests.verdict: Baseline recorded. Linux-only lanes are explicitly untested on this host; PSX-lane tests (tests/test_psx.py) are among the passed/skipped set and are the relevant real-tool lane for the slus-01363 production project.
